title: contracts/deep-links.json
description: The app's verified links (iOS universal links, Android App Links) for deep-links-and-universal-links. One contract feeds app.config.ts (through scripts/deep-links/link-native-config.ts), the incoming-link gate (through the embedded config) and the apple-app-site-association and assetlinks.json files written by write-well-known.mjs.

items.description: A bare lowercase host: no scheme, path or port. '*.example.com' covers every subdomain (not example.com itself).
SHA-256 of a signing certificate, upper-case hex pairs: keytool -list -v, eas credentials -p android, or Play Console > App signing (with Play App Signing, Google's key signs what people install).

hosts.description: Verified link hosts per build variant. A variant without hosts gets no applinks entitlement and no App Links filter.

webPaths.description: The web paths that open the app instead of the browser, in AASA form: '/tasks/*' (a trailing * for any rest) or an exact '/verify-email'. Every link route reachable from the web is covered; nothing else is listed, or the app opens for pages it then refuses.

wellKnownDir.description: Repo folder write-well-known.mjs writes <host>/apple-app-site-association and <host>/assetlinks.json into; each host's pair is deployed to https://<host>/.well-known/. Default 'well-known'.

appleTeamId.description: The Apple Developer Team ID (the App ID prefix) of the bundle ids; required once any variant has hosts.

androidCertFingerprints.description: SHA-256 signing certificate fingerprints per variant; required for every variant with hosts.
